title: Concept: Requirements file that trusts an additional host
description: requirements.txt declares a `--trusted-host` entry that turns TLS verification off for that host, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a `--trusted-host` entry that turns TLS verification off for that host.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through requirements.txt (pypi).
risk: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a `--trusted-host` entry that turns TLS verification off for that host.
